newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-GOOCH TIPS HICK TO WIN ENGLAND RECALL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GOOCH TIPS HICK TO WIN ENGLAND RECALL.

text.p: England selector Graham Gooch on Wednesday tipped a test recall for Graeme Hick ahead of next year's Ashes series against Australia.
Hick has been omitted for the winter tours of Zimbabwe and New Zealand after a lean 1996 season.
But Gooch, one of the favourites to replace chairman of selectors Ray Illingworth next March, said Hick's best years were still ahead of him.

"I think people who are saying that's his lot' at test level and he won't be able to get back' are being a little foolish," said the former England captain. "He is still only 30 and the best years of his career are probably still to materialise.
"His record is quite exceptional. He still has so much to play for and I would certainly expect him to come bouncing back."
